sentences.text: It is submitted that the subject matter of the appeal is less than Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees ten lakhs only) and the appeal before this Court is not maintainable in view of the provisions of Section 19(1) of the Karnataka Civil Courts Act, 1964.
2. The Registry is directed to return the original papers to the counsel for the appellant, after taking photocopies of the same along with the quantum of Court fee permitted to be refunded.
Six weeks time is granted to the appellant to re-present the same before the jurisdictional District Court.
3. Accordingly, the appeal is disposed of.
